verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a first-party natural-language interface. Users can get logs or charts "by simply asking in natural language", chat with the AI SRE online, in Slack (by tagging @betterstack), in MS Teams, or in Claude Code and Claude Desktop through its MCP server. The AI SRE proposes actions such as Linear tickets but never acts without user approval. missing for 10: explicit evidence that operational actions (creating monitors, acknowledging or resolving incidents, editing schedules) can be driven by natural language rather than only queries and investigation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the NL experience.
